<thought>Search the template catalog for a retrosynthetic template that performs nitro‑to‑amine reduction (breaks a nitro group and forms a primary amine) on the sulfonamide product.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "CC(C)(C)OC(=O)N1CCN(c2cc(N)cc3c2OC2(CCC2)CC3)CC1S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(F)Cl",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["nitro"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["primary amines"],
    "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
